justification: Changes when a council list read counts as ok and which earlier list it is compared with; chapter checks unchanged.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_monitor_council_results run 4: 8 ok, 6 blocked, 1 error, 1 no_scraper; Canterbury Bankstown list fixture 2026-10-22 has 70 links.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: anomaly was only produced by the hub-count gate, so a homepage or error page with links was saved ok and became the list compared with next day; previous_list ignored which page.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses the anomaly outcome and dcp_monitor_council_results; no schema change.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a list keeping under half the last good links, or a page redirected off its address, is saved as ok
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 11 hand mutants all killed; 4 Woollahra reader tests failed on the first run because their fake reply had no url, fixed by giving it one.

functions.name: shrank
functions.input: the last good list and today's list of link entries
functions.output: True when today keeps fewer than half of the last good links
functions.if_none: no previous list is a first scan and returns False

functions.name: check_not_redirected
functions.input: the requested list page address and the final address
functions.output: raises HubScrapeError when host or path differ
functions.if_none: no final address is treated as not redirected

functions.name: council_list_checked
functions.input: council, page address, discovered links, held chapters, probe, send, now
functions.output: alert lines; an anomaly row instead of ok when the list shrank
functions.if_none: a page with no links is recorded as empty, which is red

break_it.scenario: A council retires its DCP page and redirects to the homepage
break_it.what_happens: silent: the homepage list saved ok becomes yesterday
break_it.how: final address off the page raises, recorded as error, red

break_it.scenario: An error page that still shows a few PDF links
break_it.what_happens: silent: saved ok, every real document later looks new
break_it.how: under half kept = anomaly, not saved as the list

break_it.scenario: A second page (notices) for the same council
break_it.what_happens: each page would diff against the other

post_merge.manual_verify: Next daily run: dcp_monitor_council_results shows no anomaly for the 8 councils that read ok in run 4, unless their page really changed.
